qc.label_under_test: In English text, the word right after which a number is the expected next token: a month name or 'founded in' before a year, a US state abbreviation before a ZIP code, or 'and' between the two parts of a compound amount (hours and minutes, dollars and cents); the number itself need not follow, and words where no number is expected stay quiet
qc.notes: Picked for its link to the echoes map (predictable numbers). The label claims 'and' in compound amounts, but its own test read those at 0.02-0.13, and probes of other number-expecting words read low or negative ('turn to page' -0.12, 'Read Chapter' -0.02, 'retired aged' 0.12, 'two hours and' -0.01). This refine keeps years, dates and ZIP codes and makes the other number slots near misses. I read this pole's earlier test before writing mine (the brief asks to read it after drafting): none of its sentences or frames are reused, and these 16 sentences were scored 0 times before this commit.

neighbours.label: the word right before a calendar or postal number: a year after 'in' / 'founded in' / a month name, a day after a month name, a ZIP code after a US state abbreviation; other places where a number is expected (page, chapter, room, extension, age, a count, the second part of 'hours and minutes') stay quiet
